newsitem.title: USA: Gartner buying 40 pct of Fox Industries.
newsitem.headline: Gartner buying 40 pct of Fox Industries.

text.p: Gartner Group Inc said Thursday it had agreed to buy 40 percent of Fox Industries Inc, a provider of Internet content and World Wide Web solutions.

"Our strategic investment in Fox is important because the Internet is becoming a primary channel for doing business with our clients," Gartner's president of emerging businesses, Michael Fleisher, said in a statement.

"This partnership will give us full access to the Web resources we need to maintain our leadership in interactive technology-based training, and further our development in providing research and analysis via the Internet and client intranets."
